title: CSCI 603 — Computational Problem Solving
subject: Algorithms and Theory
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and apply the core components of a disciplined solution: problem specification, correctness argument, and resource bounds.
Represent and manipulate elementary data structures (lists, stacks, queues, trees, hash tables, graphs) using appropriate invariants and access rules.
Formulate and execute a problem-solving workflow that integrates pseudo-code expression, recursive decomposition, and systematic debugging/testing.
